title: F. Heartbeat
statement:
For an array u_1, u_2, …, u_n, define

You are given three cost arrays: [a_1, a_2, …, a_n], [b_1, b_2, …, b_n], and [c_0, c_1, …, c_{n-1}].

Define the cost of an array that has x prefix maximums, y suffix maximums, and z ascents as a_x·b_y·c_z.

Let the sum of costs of all permutations of 1,2,…,n be f(n). Find f(1), f(2), ..., f(n) modulo 998,244,353.

The first line contains an integer n (1≤ n≤ 700).

The second line contains n integers a_1,…,a_n (0≤ a_i < 998,244,353).

The third line contains n integers b_1,…,b_n (0≤ b_i < 998,244,353).

The fourth line contains n integers c_0,…,c_{n-1} (0≤ c_i < 998,244,353).

Print n integers: the i-th one is f(i) modulo 998,244,353.

In the second example:

The sum of all permutations' costs is 34, so f(3)=34.

Input:
```
31 1 11 1 11 1 1
```

Output:
```
1 2 6 
```

Input:
```
31 2 32 3 13 1 2
```

Output:
```
6 13 34 
```

Input:
```
51 4 2 5 32 5 1 3 4300000000 100000000 500000000 400000000 200000000
```

Output:
```
600000000 303511294 612289529 324650937 947905622 
```
